WPMS No. 279 of 2011
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Ms. Vandana Singh, Advocate, 
holding brief of Mr. Siddhartha Singh, 
Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. N.S. Pundir, Deputy Advocate 
General with Mr. Ramesh Chandra Joshi, 
Brief Holder for the State of 
Uttarakhand.
Heard learned counsel for the 
parties.
Cause shown is sufficient to allow 
the application. Consequently, the delay 
condonation application (CLMA No. 2951 
of 2016) is allowed and the delay in filing 
the substitution application is condoned. 
Having heard, though I am inclined 
to allow the substitution application, but 
it cannot be an unconditional order.
Subject to payment of cost of 
` 1,000/- by the petitioner to 
Uttarakhand High Court Lawyers Welfare 
Fund, to be deposited within ten days 
from today, the substitution application 
(CLMA No. 2953 of 2016) will stand 
allowed.
Petitioner to produce amended 
memo of parties in the Registry, within 
two weeks. 
Setting aside abatement application 
(CLMA No. 2952 of 2016) stands 
disposed of. 
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 07.09.2021
Arpan
